# slide-deck-composer
A clone-and-inject engine for real .pptx decks, hardened one real bug at a time

## What changed after the first ship
- Grouped shapes: text and pictures nested inside a group are now real, scorable candidates, not invisible
- A custom layout: any real template shape becomes usable, not just the 6 named ones
- Per-shape font resolution: checks a shape's real font, not just the theme's declared one
- Real ECMA-376 schema validation: 24 real XSD files, not 7 self-authored guesses

slots.text: Four rounds, each earning the next
Four hardening rounds, one real deck compiled and rendered each time
v0.1-0.3: clone-and-inject engine, 6 layouts, Vietnamese font-safety, font-size balancing
v0.4: real OOXML group support -- text and pictures nested in a group finally became visible
v0.5: a cold agent's real client brief found 2 real bugs no self-test had caught
v0.6-0.7: per-shape font resolution, then real ECMA-376 schema validation
Grouped shapes were invisible to this engine until v0.4 -- real templates hide content in them
A cold agent chose the custom layout for 5 of 9 slides on its first real client brief
Font safety used to check only the theme -- a real template's font hid one layer deeper
Every fix here was verified by rendering the output, not by trusting a clean report

## Two things this build got right
### Infrastructure, not judgment
- A thumbnail grid, not a heuristic guessing the right slide
- shape_roles scores real geometry; the agent decides which slide actually fits
### Verify before trusting
- Every claim in this deck was rendered and looked at, not assumed from a JSON report
- A cold agent with a real brief found two real bugs no self-test caught
# One working, audited skill beats ten unused ones in the registry

## What's next
Layout coverage for stat callouts and icon grids -- now that custom has proven exactly where the real demand is
